correctness.rationale: For a pure forgetful input, all \(\Phi_p\) images are pure because bond images have trivial permutation. Moving the pure bond factors across braid blocks shows that each bond contributes \(p\) times one permuted Artin basis vector in \(H_1(P_n;\mathbb Z)\). The resulting slope vector is intrinsic, nonnegative, and has coordinate sum equal to bond degree. Summing coordinates gives the asserted total-linking formula, which separates distinct p.

value.rationale: The result gives the new algebraic family \(\Phi_p\) a direct topological meaning: positive bond degree forces an exact, nonzero linking-number speed and therefore produces an infinite family of distinct oriented classical links from one pure bonded braid.
